**Finding: Compliant (at fallback) — no redline proposed.**

The agreement does contain a minimum commitment (Section 5a: fees "not less than $____ per month" for Hosting and Support Services), so it does not reach our preferred no-minimum position. But it lands squarely on the fallback:

- **Term is 12 months**, renewing in one-year increments with a 30-day non-renewal right (Section 13).
- **Exit exists**: Section 14 lets Client terminate on written notice, with service and fees running only to the last day of the month following the notice month — effectively a 30–60 day convenience exit.
- **No penalty mechanics**: no shortfall charge, take-or-pay make-whole, early termination fee, or volume cap on our usage.
- The "not less than ____ months" figure in Section 4 is TrueLink's resourcing commitment *to us*, which we should not disturb.

Two points flagged for commercial follow-up rather than redline: the dollar minimums in Section 5a (and the month figure in Section 4) remain blank and should be kept modest when completed, and Section 6 carves the minimum monthly fees out of our documentation and dispute rights — worth watching once the numbers are filled in.
